  • ★☆☆☆☆ June 25, 2026

    -Water in the showers was luke warm and never got hot even after 20 minutes of running it on the hottest setting -View was partial ocean view and I paid for ocean view -Very hot in hallways and elevator -Bathroom door was very loud when sliding it to open and close it -Mini fridge didn't get cold -No patio chairs -Wifi was horrible and no cell service inside of room - Bath tub drain didn't work properly, bathtub would not hold the luke warm water -Shower head was old and had bad calcium build up -No usb chargers in room, I've stayed in cheaper hotels that at least had usb ports in lamps and wall outlets - Toilet would start running for no reason -Patio door was extremely hard to open and close -Horrible beds, I weigh 120lbs and I sunk down low in the bed -Room never cooled down, it was warm and muggy the entire time even at night -Ac made loud noises all night -Toilet was extremely hard to flush, the handle was hard to push down -Carpet felt moist when walking barefoot -When the guests in the rooms on both sides of us used the shower we could hear the loud noise it made in our room at 11pm at night

  • ★★☆☆☆ June 24, 2026

    For Hyatt, this oceanfront property missed the mark totally on service and luxury standards. The staff provided no interaction with no greetings or good mornings. I even tried to talk to them and they seemed to be to busy to even say hello. The breakfast buffet was totally dirty and there was no plates, silverware or glasses for juice. Dining area was a wreck and tables were so dirty. I had to clean off (wipe it down) the table before we could eat. In the room, there was virtually no water pressure in the shower, and the AC didn't work well — the space always felt wet and clammy rather than properly cooled. The room stunk and felt dirty. This sure wasn't luxury and the price was high for not being luxury. We will not be returning to this location.

  • ★★★☆☆ June 19, 2026

    We've stayed at many Hyatt properties and this was by far the worst experience we've had. On arrival, we had nowhere to park since the parking lot was full. There was no one at the front desk so we ended up calling at midnight just to get assistance. We had to park across the street behind a gift shop. Once inside, the room's AC wasn't working properly in the middle of summer, which made for an uncomfortable stay. The AC vent was also being blocked by a giant lamp. The hallway had no AC either and a noticeable smell. Small things added up too: the in-room phone didn't work, the elevator was slow and inconvenient, and the shower pressure was uncomfortably intense. Breakfast was equally disappointing and did nothing to redeem the stay. The pool needed some trees or decorations to make it feel more cozy. At least the beds were comfortable and the view was great. The overall vibe was just off — it didn't feel like the Hyatt standard we're used to. We will not be returning to this property and hope management takes these issues seriously, because this location has a lot of catching up to do.

  • ★★★☆☆ June 16, 2026

    As a Hyatt Globalist, this oceanfront property misses the mark on service and luxury standards. Staff provided minimal interaction with no greetings or good mornings. The breakfast buffet was embarrassing and basic compared to higher-end Hyatts — limited options like scrambled eggs, sausage, breakfast potatoes, toast, yogurt, fruit, and granola. Dining area overlooks a parking lot leading to the beach, and sand tracks everywhere due to proximity. In the room, there was virtually no water pressure in the shower, and the AC didn't work well — the space always felt wet and clammy rather than properly cooled. Rooms and location suit a basic beach stay if you don't expect premium service or amenities. Fine for convenience, not luxury.

  • ★★☆☆☆ June 14, 2026

    Me and my family have been staying at the hyatt for years and we're ecstatic to see there was one on daytona since we were going to spend one night there mid roadtrip but only left with disappointment. The breakfast had good food (first time seeing cinnamon rolls at a Hyatt), the room was decent and the view was awesome. However the room is very outdated and definitely needs a revamp. For starters we had 2 rooms and the AC didnt work in one so we had to get a different room. In our room the door would make this loud scratching noise, making us scared because we felt like it was about to break anytime we opened or closed it, along with that the door also didnt have a way of locking, it seems like there is supposed to be a handle there but there wasnt. We also went to get extra keys in the lobby and the front desk man had an attitude claiming we weren't in that room anymore because of the AC issue but we had to tell him we had 2 rooms and we wanted extra keys for the one that didnt move. Whilst also going out later, another man was waiting to check in and said he had been waiting almost half an hour to check in, we had a similar issue that it seems almost everytime we went for something, no one was at the front desk and we would have to wait for someone to show up. We love the hyatt and we're so disappointed with this hyatt. Hope they can renovate soon and keep up to par with the other hyatt's.

  • ★★☆☆☆ June 6, 2026

    This oceanfront location has incredible views. Being able to just sit and watch the ocean is a favorite of mine. What this place has in views does not really make up for everything else.
